blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Ground truth in Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is often presented as a single categorical fact, yet an acted emotion and the emotion heard by listeners describe different aspects of the same recording. We examine this distinction in Emozionalmente, an acted Italian corpus that provides both an elicited production label and five listener judgements for every clip. Using frozen XLS-R, HuBERT, and WavLM representations with matched probes, we compare three label authorities: the expressed condition, the listeners' hard plurality, and their complete vote distribution. The results tell a consistent story. Recovering the expressed condition is easier than predicting a tie-broken listener plurality, but that gap compares two different questions rather than revealing a general loss of SER ability. As listener agreement weakens, the plurality becomes an increasingly brittle hard target. Training on the full vote distribution does not substantially change which class wins the model's hard decision, but it produces probability assignments that more closely follow the alternatives selected by listeners, especially for ambiguous clips. No authority therefore replaces the others. Expressed labels describe how speech was produced, pluralities provide an operational single-class decision, and vote distributions preserve perceptual uncertainty. For human-facing Internet of Sounds applications, evaluations should state which authority is being predicted, retain its aggregation rule and agreement information, and use distributional scores when disagreement is part of the target.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is usually formulated as classification: an
utterance enters a model and one emotion label comes out. The apparent
simplicity of that formulation hides a prior decision about what the label is
supposed to mean. In acted corpora, it commonly records the emotion requested
during data collection. Such a label is a useful and reproducible description
of the production protocol, but it is not a direct observation of what a
listener heard, and still less of what a speaker privately felt. Conversely, a
listener label records a perceptual judgement whose meaning depends on who
listened, under which conditions, and how several judgements were aggregated.
Expression–perception mismatches have been documented even in widely used
emotional-speech resources [ 1 ] . Calling both
sources “ground truth” without qualification therefore makes two different
questions look like one.

human-facing Internet of Sounds application. A semantic archive may index how

elicited production condition while disagreeing with its users, or match a
listener plurality while concealing that the plurality was decided by a tie.

We call this choice the label-authority problem . It concerns which
observation is authorized to define success, rather than whether one annotation
file is cleaner than another. We investigate the problem in Emozionalmente, a
crowdsourced Italian corpus of simulated emotional speech that provides an
elicited production label and five independent post-hoc recognition judgements
for every clip [ 2 ] . The corpus makes it possible to
study three operational authorities on exactly the same audio: the expressed
condition, a single recognized class obtained by plurality, and the complete
distribution of listener votes. None is assumed to be universally correct.
Each describes a different aspect of the recording and induces a different
evaluation question.

The study follows that distinction from people to models. It first asks how the
expressed condition and listener responses diverge before any classifier is
introduced. It then compares matched probes on frozen XLS-R, HuBERT, and WavLM

in the training target. Finally, it asks whether distributional supervision
retains perceptual alternatives that disappear when five votes are collapsed
to one tie-broken class. Run-to-run variation, paired clip bootstraps,
agreement-stratified analyses, and configuration-matched sensitivities are used
for different uncertainty questions; the many layer conditions are not treated
as independent experimental replicates.

The resulting picture is more informative than a ranking of three targets.
Recovering the expressed condition is easier than predicting a listener
plurality, but the corresponding scores refer to different tasks. The plurality
becomes increasingly brittle as agreement weakens. Soft supervision does not
materially change hard plurality UAR on the full test split, yet it gives
probability distributions that are substantially closer to the complete vote
histograms, especially on ambiguous clips. Model confusions also concentrate
on the same emotion pairs that human listeners confuse most often. Together,
these observations support a task-dependent reporting rule: name the label
authority, preserve its aggregation and agreement information, and use a
proper distributional score when disagreement is part of the phenomenon being
modelled.

blocks.zh: 二. 背景情况

blocks.en: II-A Authority Is Not Reliability

blocks.en:
SER surveys describe a field in which corpus design, emotion representation,
and evaluation protocol vary substantially [ 3 , 4 ] . Acted resources remain useful because their elicitation
procedures provide balanced and interpretable production conditions. Italian
corpora such as EMOVO and DEMoS, for example, deliberately record performed
emotions under controlled protocols [ 5 , 6 ] . IEMOCAP combines elicited interaction with several
forms of annotation and thereby illustrates how one recording can support
multiple descriptions [ 7 ] . The methodological issue is not
that an acted label is false. It is that a production label, a perception label,
and a felt-emotion report are observations of different constructs.

Reliability coefficients describe how consistently annotators apply a scheme [ 8 ] . They do not decide whether a study should
predict the elicited condition, a listener consensus, or an individual

from the production protocol; an imperfectly reliable panel can still provide
valuable evidence about perceptual ambiguity. The authority identifies the
estimand. Reliability characterizes the evidence available for that authority.

blocks.en: II-B From Consensus Labels to Distributions
blocks.zh: 从共识标签到分发

blocks.en:
A plurality turns several judgements into the single class required by a
conventional classifier. This is operationally convenient, but the conversion
is lossy. Minority responses disappear, the strength of the winning class is
hidden, and ties require an external rule. The resulting hard target can make a
model look wrong even when it favours an alternative selected by equally many
listeners. Agreement statistics and plurality accuracy therefore answer
different questions: one describes the panel, while the other scores a model
against the panel’s compressed outcome.

blocks.en: II-C Frozen Representations as a Diagnostic
blocks.zh: II-C 冻结代表作为诊断

blocks.en:
Self-supervised speech models provide a common representational substrate for
the comparison. XLS-R learns multilingual acoustic representations through a
wav2vec 2.0-style contrastive objective [ 17 ] ; HuBERT predicts
cluster-derived hidden units [ 18 ] ; and WavLM extends masked
speech modelling to noisy and overlapping conditions [ 19 ] .
Freezing these backbones and varying only shallow probes makes the experiment a
diagnostic of accessible information under matched conditions. It deliberately
does not answer how end-to-end fine-tuning, larger annotation panels, or a
different corpus would change the result.

blocks.en:
The three probe families deliberately add limited trainable capacity. The
historically named linear probe mean-pools one selected hidden state,
projects 1,024 features to 128 with a ReLU, and maps the result to seven logits.
The dense probe first applies two frame-wise 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutions
with 256 channels and ReLU activations, then mean-pools and classifies. It can
transform each frame non-linearly but does not model new temporal interactions.
The agg_dense probe assigns a learned scalar to every one of the 25
available states–the convolutional state numbered 0 and Transformer layers
1–24–normalizes those scalars with a softmax, and sends the weighted sequence
through the dense head. Thus, the 25 points in its layer-weight plots are all
states made available to the aggregation probe; they are distinct from the ten
depths sampled by the single-layer probes.

blocks.en: IV-B Splits and Training
blocks.zh: 四-B 分成和培训

blocks.en:
A fixed speaker-independent split assigns 4,142 clips to training, 1,380 to
validation, and 1,380 to testing. Every speaker occurs in one partition only,
and the same audio assignment is used for all authorities. Hard targets use
categorical cross-entropy; the recognized distribution uses soft
cross-entropy against the unsmoothed empirical vote vector. Probes are trained
for 30 epochs with Adam at a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} . The retained checkpoint
maximizes validation accuracy for hard targets and minimizes validation soft
cross-entropy for the distributional target. Five runs vary probe
initialization and minibatch order while holding the split, features, and
settings fixed.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: VI-A Ground Truth as a Task Specification
blocks.zh: 将地面真相作为任务规格

blocks.en:
The three authorities are related, but they are not interchangeable versions
of the same label. The expressed condition identifies what the speaker was
asked to perform. The recognized plurality identifies the class that wins after
five perceptions are compressed by an aggregation and tie rule. The recognized
distribution retains the alternatives chosen by those listeners. Each can be a
legitimate target, provided that the system’s claim is phrased in terms of the
question that target can answer.

同一标签。 所表述的条件表明发言者是什么。

blocks.en:
This distinction changes the meaning of error. An expressed-label error misses
the elicited condition. A plurality error misses the panel’s operational winner,
which may itself depend on a tie-break. A distributional error places
probability differently from the observed pattern of votes. Treating these
events as one generic failure obscures the main result. The own-reference hard
UAR gap does not reveal a universal reduction in SER capability; it shows that
recovering the performed condition and predicting the perceptual winner are
different tasks. Cross-evaluation confirms that the representations retain
information about both, while the agreement analysis explains why one hard
reference becomes less stable on ambiguous clips.

Human–model confusion alignment adds an interpretive layer. The models do not
simply become noisy when listener labels are introduced. Their most frequent

does not make every model error a human-like perception, nor does a top-10

blocks.en: VI-B Implications for Internet of Sounds Systems
blocks.zh: 语音系统对互联网的影响

blocks.en:
For a connected audio system, label authority is part of the system
specification rather than a detail of dataset preparation. A production archive
may legitimately index the intended affect of recorded material. A user-facing
search engine may instead need to retrieve clips by likely perceived affect. An
accessibility service or affect-aware interface may need to expose uncertainty
when listeners would disagree, because an overconfident adaptation can be more
harmful than a deferred decision. The same audio model cannot be evaluated for
all three purposes by changing only the prose around one score.
blocks.zh:
对于连接的音频系统,标签权限是系统的一部分
规格而不是数据集编制的细节。 制作归档
可合法地将记录材料的预期影响指数化。 面向用户
搜索引擎可能需要通过可能察觉到的影响检索剪辑。 一个
无障碍服务或影响意识接口可能需要暴露不确定性
当听众不同意, 因为过度自信的适应 可能更
比推迟的决定有害。 无法评价同一音频模式
所有三个目的,只改变 流言围绕一个分数。

blocks.en:
This has consequences at the dataset and service boundary. Production
condition, vote counts, annotator count, aggregation rule, and quality metadata
should remain separate fields rather than being overwritten by one
“ground-truth” class. A service can still derive a categorical label when a
routing or retrieval interface requires it. Preserving provenance allows that
decision to be audited, recalculated under another rule, or accompanied by an
agreement threshold. It also allows a downstream component to request more
annotations or abstain when the perceptual evidence is diffuse.

blocks.en:
The present study does not evaluate networking, latency, or deployment. Its
Internet of Sounds contribution is upstream: it clarifies what an affective
audio component is being asked to predict and which evidence should accompany
that prediction before the component is embedded in a connected application.
Testing whether the proposed metadata and uncertainty signals improve a
deployed interaction remains future work.

blocks.en: VI-C A Reporting Protocol for Label Authority
blocks.zh: 标签管理局报告议定书

blocks.en:
Three reporting practices follow from the evidence. First, an expressed-label
score should be described as recovery of an elicited production condition, not
automatically as perceived-emotion accuracy. Second, when one listener-derived
class is required, the aggregation rule, tie policy, panel size, and agreement
strata should be reported with the hard score. Third, when perceptual ambiguity
is itself the target, the vote distribution should be retained and evaluated
with a proper score; any hard decision should be reported separately.

blocks.en: VII Limitations and Outlook
blocks.zh: 七. 限制和前景

blocks.en:
The evidence comes from one corpus, one language, simulated emotional speech,
and five votes per clip. Another listener panel could change a weak plurality,
and cultural or contextual differences could change the confusion structure.
The good-quality sensitivity check shows that filtering lower-quality ratings
does not remove the main pattern, but it cannot separate cultural, contextual,
and individual sources of disagreement. Follow-up annotation should retain
evaluator identities and collect enough judgements to estimate both rater- and
clip-level variation.

证据来自一个实体 一种语言 模拟情感演讲
每集5张票 另一个听者面板可以改变一个弱的多元性,
文化差异或背景差异可能改变混淆结构。
高质量敏感性检查显示过滤质量较低的评分
不删除主模式,但不能将文化、背景、
和个别的分歧来源。 后续说明应予保留
评价员的身份并收集足够的判断,以估计评估员和
剪辑级别变化。

blocks.en:
The observed vote histograms are finite samples rather than latent perceptual
distributions. KL and Brier therefore contain sampling variation even for a
well-specified model. Subtracting a shared finite-vote reference level would
preserve between-target differences on the same clips, but it would not turn a
raw score into pure model error or justify unqualified comparisons between
agreement strata. A larger or repeated annotation panel is needed to study how
stable the inferred distributions are.
blocks.zh:
观测到的投票直方图是有限的样本,而不是潜在的知觉
分发。 KL和Brier因此包含一些取样变异,甚至对于一个
精确的模型。 减去共同的有限票数参考水平

协议层。 需要有一个更大的或重复的注解面板来研究如何

blocks.en:
The modelling scope is similarly bounded. Frozen backbones and shallow probes
measure what is accessible without updating the speech representation; they do
not establish what end-to-end fine-tuning can learn. Checkpoints use validation
data, but the best layers and individual winners were chosen by mean test UAR.
Winner-based results are consequently descriptive and optimistic. The paired
bootstrap conditions on those fitted and selected models. A confirmatory study
should predeclare its contrasts, select all hyperparameters on validation data,
and reserve an untouched test set for interval estimation.

在不更新发言说明的情况下衡量哪些内容是无障碍的;
没有确定端到端的微调能学到什么. 检查站使用验证

blocks.en:
Cross-corpus validation is also necessary. Grossi et al. report limited transfer
from Emozionalmente intended-label training to external speech subsets [ 20 ] . That result motivates replication but cannot isolate
label authority because speakers, acoustics, class support, and annotation all
change together. A stronger extension would collect or align production labels,
pluralities, and vote distributions across languages and across acted and
spontaneous speech under one protocol. Fine-tuned and frozen models could then
be compared without changing the measurement question.

blocks.en:
The layer-mixture analysis should also remain exploratory. The target-dependent
profiles suggest that different authorities draw on frozen representations in
different ways, but the weights are correlated fitted coefficients rather than
causal attributions. Aggregation and single-layer probes also differ in their
inputs and selection procedures. These observations motivate a
validation-selected representation study; they do not identify one universally
optimal layer or backbone.

blocks.en: VIII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 八 结论

blocks.en:
Within Emozionalmente, label authority changes both what an SER system is asked
to predict and how its output should be evaluated. Expressed labels provide a
controlled account of production. Listener pluralities provide an operational
single-class decision, but become brittle as agreement weakens. Vote
distributions preserve the perceptual alternatives that a hard plurality
discards, and distributional supervision represents those alternatives more
faithfully even when hard UAR changes little.
blocks.zh:
在 Emozionalmente 中,标签权限会改变对 SER 系统的要求
预测和如何评价其产出。 表示的标签提供a
控制生产情况。 听众复数提供操作
单级决定,但随着协议的削弱而变得脆弱. 票数
分布保留了硬多元性的认知替代品
丢弃物和分配监督更代表这些替代品
即使困难的UAR改变不大,

blocks.en:
No authority therefore replaces every other ground truth. The practical lesson
is to make the authority visible: state what generated the label, preserve how
